meta.detail_rows: one row per (market × horizon), including missing/invalid rows with status/reason
meta.historical_baseline_rule: For market i and horizon h, p_hist_i,h is computed using only prior markets with umaEndDate <= earnings_release_datetime_i - horizon_h - historical_margin; if none, p_hist_i,h=0.5
meta.event_anchor_rule: earnings_release_datetime is the anchor for horizon timing
meta.historical_availability_rule: umaEndDate is used as the timestamp by which prior outcomes are considered available
meta.summary_rule: by-horizon summary computed over rows with usable_polymarket=True (baselines on same sample)
